description: External repo holdouts for offline Repo Radar evals. These are not loaded by the runtime default calibration corpus. Positive, negative, and mixed labels are kept here to test whether the reviewer can recognize good and poor taste without being anchored by the same examples it saw at runtime.

evals.label: positive
evals.prompt: Review the repo at https://github.com/postgres/postgres pinned to 422e54e3092afd09997d27cc7c99598f91075b0d with Repo Radar for code taste. Produce a concise evidence-backed report with scores, strengths, taste smells, recommendations, calibration comparison, verification and agent fit, and confidence limits.
evals.expected_output: A positive but nuanced report that recognizes mature architecture, explanatory comments, docs, and tests while downgrading confidence when sampling only part of a large codebase.
expected_findings: Mature architecture and contributor docs support long-term maintainability.
Comments and docs explain intent and subsystem context.
Confidence should be scoped because the repository is very large.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not call PostgreSQL tasteful merely because it is popular or old.
Do not generalize database-grade process to small application repos.

expectations.text: Report includes the required repo-radar sections: Verdict, Inferred project values, Scores, Strengths, Taste Smells, Recommendations, Calibration Comparison, Verification and Agent Fit, and Confidence Limits.
Report cites concrete repo evidence from README.md, src/backend/, src/test/, or doc/src/sgml/.
Report gives a positive but not uncritical verdict for the holdout repo.
Report includes calibration comparison against the default corpus or named calibration repositories.
Report states confidence limits for a large repository sample.

evals.expected_output: A positive but bounded report that recognizes standard-library API readability, examples, documentation, and consistency while naming the sampled package or subsystem.
expected_findings: Idiomatic names and package docs make APIs readable at call sites.

Do not recommend broad rewrites instead of naming smell families.
